name: discover-sidebar-addons-v1

provenance.bug: Theatre Discover's catalogue dropdown hid the list and overflowed the screen once a few addons were installed (Hemanth, 2026-09-29); the Discover sidebar replaces it and needs a profile with more than one catalogue source to prove switching

expectedOnBoot.value: (Cinemeta group, then Torrent Catalogs group; see discover_sidebar_catalogues.json)

contents: A fresh local profile's Theatre addon list (Cinemeta, Torrentio, NoTorrent, Anime Kitsu, OpenSubtitles v3 defaults) plus three public addons copied from Hemanth's profiles: Torrent Catalogs, Streaming Catalogs (Netflix/HBO/... categories) and The Movie Database (Popular/Year/Language/... categories). Their manifest copies are the old slimmed shape (no filter options), so a build with the store refresh re-fetches them. No account data, no tokens (his Trakt addon's URL carries one and was left out).
